description: The run is suspended after one batch; a new engine instance resumes from the persisted state without re-executing the completed stage.
note: Scripted decisions were recorded through Engine.decide by the named actor; demonstration faults are injected via Settings and labelled.
requirement: Add a per-link analytics summary endpoint GET /api/v1/links/{code}/analytics/summary returning total redirects, first and last redirect time, and redirects per day. Unknown codes return 404. Expired links keep their analytics readable.
title: Demo: interruption after one batch, resumed by a fresh engine
